taskBaseInfo.taskDescription: X1 phase-2 full training: 289-clip multi-activity library (walk/turn/dance/jog, arm fix baked into the retarget pipeline), 60k iterations, 4096 envs, 1x4090D, wall_hours cap 10 (~Y58 max). Budget mapping in docs/X1_PHASE2_DATASET.md. Entry scripts/gm_x1_train.py with configs/x1_supermimic_phase2.json; eval every 2h against the in-sample library; mirrors log.jsonl to TensorBoard under logs/x1_phase2/ and publishes the newest checkpoint to output/.
